up: Show all IC50 activity records for CHEMBL5498743 and its salt forms against target CHEMBL612267. Include the following columns: compound CHEMBL ID, compound name, canonical SMILES, activity ID, assay ID, document ID, PubMed ID, DOI, assay description, standard value, standard units, standard relation, and pChEMBL value.
sql:
WITH
 compound_set AS (
   -- Start with the specified parent compound
   SELECT molregno, chembl_id, pref_name
   FROM molecule_dictionary
   WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5498743'

   UNION

   -- Add all salt forms (children) via molecule_hierarchy
   SELECT md.molregno, md.chembl_id, md.pref_name
   FROM molecule_dictionary parent
   JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.parent_molregno = parent.molregno
   JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON md.molregno = mh.molregno
   WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5498743'
 )
SELECT
   cs.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
   cs.pref_name AS compound_name,
   struct.canonical_smiles,
   act.activity_id,
   act.assay_id,
   act.doc_id,
   docs.pubmed_id,
   docs.doi,
   ass.description AS assay_description,
   act.standard_value,
   act.standard_units,
   act.standard_relation,
   act.pchembl_value
FROM compound_set cs
JOIN activities act ON act.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON ass.assay_id = act.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON td.tid = ass.tid
LEFT JOIN compound_structures struct ON struct.molregno = cs.molregno
LEFT JOIN docs ON docs.doc_id = act.doc_id
WHERE
   td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL612267'
   AND act.standard_type = 'IC50';
